headline: Keppel DC REIT Nine-Month Distribution Per Unit Climbs 11.7% on Acquisitions
summary: Keppel DC REIT posted an 11.7 percent increase in distribution per unit to 8.571 Singapore cents for the first nine months, supported by asset acquisitions and organic portfolio growth.
why: Keppel DC REIT is Asia's first pure-play data center real estate investment trust, benefiting directly from demand driven by cloud computing and artificial intelligence.

impacts.name: Keppel DC REIT
impacts.why: Higher distributable income from organic growth and acquisitions reinforces payout stability for unitholders.
